**Diagnosis:** [AffectedProcess.ListenPorts](/app/models/packages.go:176) is declared as `[]ListenPort` under the `listenPorts` JSON key. [Report loading](/app/report/util.go:746) unmarshals saved results into that type, so a legacy string element causes the reported error.

The fix spans the model and its consumers: keep `listenPorts` as `[]string`, add `ListenPortStats []PortStat`, `NewPortStat`, and `HasReachablePort` in [packages.go](/app/models/packages.go); update destination selection, matching, and reachability in [scan/base.go](/app/scan/base.go:742); update the scan producers in [debian.go](/app/scan/debian.go:1297) and [redhatbase.go](/app/scan/redhatbase.go:494); and update display code in [report/util.go](/app/report/util.go:265) and [report/tui.go](/app/report/tui.go:722).

Existing [scan tests](/app/scan/base_test.go:300) cover deduplication, wildcard expansion, nil slices, and matching, but use the current field and type. I found no test for legacy JSON decoding or malformed port input. I did not run tests or edit project source or tests; this run was restricted to fault localization.

Updated `AffectedProcess` so legacy `listenPorts` string arrays decode successfully. New scans use `ListenPortStats` and `PortStat` for destination selection and reachability; report views can display both formats.

Added tests for legacy JSON, port parsing, reachability, and nil-safe updates. `go test -p 1 ./models ./scan ./report` and `git diff --check` pass.

VERDICT: FIX

The patch parses legacy string entries, but [AffectedProcess.ListenPorts](/app/models/packages.go:181) now rejects object entries written by the previous schema. [Report loading](/app/report/util.go:750) will fail on those saved results. Add a compatibility decoder that accepts both forms and preserves reachability data.

`GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./models ./scan ./report` passed for all three packages. There was no test environment problem. Review only; no project code or tests were changed.

Fixed JSON loading for both saved `listenPorts` formats. String entries populate `ListenPorts`; object entries populate `ListenPortStats`, preserving saved reachability data. Added regression tests.

The reviewer’s exact command, `GOPROXY=off GOSUMDB=off go test ./models ./scan ./report`, passed.
